hyatt-regency.title: Application & Feasibility
hyatt-regency.body: Evaluate demand fit, property condition, and conversion or new-build scope against Hyatt Regency brand standards before commitment. CALA property examples (Mexico City, Mexico, Cancún, Mexico) provide reference points for achievable scope. Test whether the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth is credible versus Grand Hyatt.

hyatt-regency.title: CALA Market Relevance
hyatt-regency.body: Hyatt Regency has verified CALA references in Mexico City, Mexico, Cancún, Mexico, providing property-level diligence anchors for regional owners. These examples demonstrate operating-model execution and guest-experience delivery in CALA demand contexts rather than parent-platform averages. Keep Hyatt Regency product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

hyatt-regency.title: Brand Positioning Evidence
hyatt-regency.body: Hyatt Regency positioning is anchored in official brand documentation and verified property-level examples where available. Hyatt Regency brand page and development materials provide the canonical identity reference for owner diligence. CALA operating proof from Mexico City, Mexico, Cancún, Mexico supports regional owners evaluating affiliation.

hyatt-regency.title: Growth Editorial
hyatt-regency.body: Hyatt Regency growth should be evaluated through brand-specific positioning, not Hyatt Hotels Corporation expansion targets alone. Underwrite Hyatt Regency as Hyatt’s core upper-upscale full-service meetings brand—never as Grand Hyatt prestige intensity, Centric lifestyle exploration, or Hyatt Place select-service economics. CALA markets (Mexico City, Mexico, Cancún, Mexico) already demonstrate operating proof for this positioning.

hyatt-regency.title: Proof Points
hyatt-regency.body:
- Official brand positioning for Hyatt Regency is anchored in Hyatt brand and development materials specific to this brand—not Hyatt Hotels Corporation corporate copy
- Geography posture is CALA-supported with named examples in Mexico City, Mexico, Cancún, Mexico — property cards follow those labels
- Owner distinction focus separates Hyatt Regency from Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Centric, Hyatt Place, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, and Westin using product, demand, and operating-model criteria
- Target guest segments — Corporate / Business, Group / MICE, Leisure — follow validated Brand Basics taxonomy options only
- Parent/platform context (Hyatt Hotels Corporation / World of Hyatt) stays labeled and subordinate to brand-specific evidence

hyatt-regency.title: Portfolio Mix
hyatt-regency.body:
Urban / suburban meetings hotels: primary
Airport / convention-adjacent full-service: strong secondary
Resort-adjacent meetings resorts: selective
Select-service or lifestyle-light boxes: weak fit Curated sample mix based on global brand positioning (illustrative, not a disclosed portfolio census).

hyatt-centric.title: Portfolio Mix
hyatt-centric.body:
Urban lifestyle corridors: primary
Walkable mixed-use / destination neighborhoods: strong secondary
Secondary city centers with explorer demand: selective
Meetings-led Regency boxes or select-service Place: wrong lane Curated sample mix based on global brand positioning (illustrative, not a disclosed portfolio census).

hyatt-centric.title: North America
hyatt-centric.body: North America is a core Hyatt Centric theater for urban lifestyle hotels such as Hyatt Centric Midtown 5th Avenue New York and Hyatt Centric Downtown Miami. Treat US examples as International Reference relative to CALA-first posture when needed, and keep Centric distinct from Regency and Place.
